writing_rule_packs.name: Writing continuity core
writing_rule_packs.intent: Preserve accepted user facts, motivation, causality, timeline, and prop state before scene expression or prompt packaging.
directives: Keep accepted user facts above KB suggestions.
Require cause and consequence for escalation.
Carry unresolved setup and payoff obligations into later stages.
negative_constraints: Do not rewrite accepted facts for stronger style.
Do not expose raw source or raw KB rows.

writing_rule_packs.name: Visible action scene expression
writing_rule_packs.intent: Convert accepted story material into scene objective, obstacle, visible action, reaction, and turning point.
directives: Expose objective, obstacle, action, reaction, and turning point.
Convert exposition into visible behavior only when original intent is preserved.
Block decorative scenes that have no causal purpose.
negative_constraints: Do not replace visible action with abstract mood.
Do not let style overwrite story facts.

director_rule_packs.name: Director scheduling core
director_rule_packs.intent: Guide performance focus, blocking, rhythm, visual attention, and scene-to-shot handoff.
directives: Blocking must clarify objective, conflict, relation, or reveal.
Rhythm may adjust emphasis but must not delete cause and effect.
Viewer attention should serve visible story function.
negative_constraints: Do not let director hints overwrite accepted story facts.
Do not expose internal evidence in storyboard rows.

director_rule_packs.name: Shot intent taxonomy
director_rule_packs.intent: Select shot intent from scene purpose and director scheduling.
directives: Use establish, reveal, pursue, clash, reaction, transition, payoff, spectacle, or detail_insert as first-pass shot intents.
Every shot intent must correspond to visible row behavior.
Shot intent must not require runtime graph traversal.
negative_constraints: Do not use intent labels alone as prompt text.
Do not create rows with no visible function.

director_rule_packs.name: Duration density
director_rule_packs.intent: Bind target duration to shot count, beat density, row duration, and validation checks.
directives: Match the target duration exactly.
Use duration-specific shot count guidance.
Reject zero-duration rows and repeated full-budget rows.
negative_constraints: Do not accept duration sum mismatch.
Do not treat zero-duration rows as success.

director_rule_packs.name: Prompt text boundary
director_rule_packs.intent: Compile clean generation-facing prompt text from accepted facts and confirmed storyboard rows.
directives: Prompt text must include subject, action, frame, camera, duration, and negative constraints.
Prompt text must align with visual_description.
Prompt text must be compiled after the confirmed row.
negative_constraints: Do not expose trace refs, schema IDs, source registers, or internal hashes.
Do not emit empty prompt text.

director_rule_packs.name: Visual master consistency
director_rule_packs.intent: Carry a compact visual master into storyboard rows while preserving accepted facts.
directives: Carry subject identity, world, palette, lighting logic, material feel, era, and key props into every storyboard row.
Vary framing and action without resetting the visual world.
Treat visual master as continuity guidance, not as a source of new facts.
negative_constraints: Do not overwrite accepted body facts.
Do not expose source images, OCR text, local paths, or source registers.

director_rule_packs.name: Camera language grammar
director_rule_packs.intent: Bind shot function, scale, angle, movement, composition, and adjacent-shot relation to PWA storyboard fields.
directives: Each row should include shot function, shot scale, camera angle, camera movement, and composition logic when useful.
Prefer precise camera language over broad cinematic quality words.
Avoid repeating the same framing and movement across all rows.
negative_constraints: Do not use camera vocabulary as empty decoration.
Do not expose internal rule ids in prompt_text.

director_rule_packs.name: Material light air physicality
director_rule_packs.intent: Add scene-bound material feedback, light direction, and air medium cues to visible frame and prompt text.
directives: Add visible material weight, resistance, wetness, roughness, wear, or reflection when tied to action.
Add light direction, hardness, rim light, side backlight, haze, rain, dust, smoke, steam, sparks, or water reflection only when supported by scene logic.
Keep physical detail bound to current action.
negative_constraints: Do not add unsupported world facts or weather effects.
Do not replace action with texture lists.

director_rule_packs.name: Expression physicalization
director_rule_packs.intent: Convert abstract emotion into visible face, posture, breath, and blocking cues that fit shot scale.
directives: Convert abstract emotion into visible performance cues.
Use close-up cues such as jaw tension, cheek muscle, locked gaze, nasal flare, lip pressure, or trembling breath only when shot scale supports them.
Use posture, silhouette, blocking, and motion for wide shots.
negative_constraints: Do not output abstract mood without visible action.
Do not force invisible micro-expression cues into wide shots.

director_rule_packs.name: Transition motion dynamics
director_rule_packs.intent: Use transitions and motion dynamics to express rhythm, continuity, action pressure, and emotional direction.
directives: Use transitions and motion dynamics to express rhythm and continuity.
Select fade, dissolve, flash, wipe, push, pull, match cut, or montage by scene function.
Select horizontal, vertical, diagonal, curved, radial, spiral, or S-curve motion by action pressure and emotional direction.
negative_constraints: Do not add decorative transitions unrelated to scene function.
Do not break action continuity or accepted event order.

director_rule_packs.name: Preproduction storyboard guide
director_rule_packs.intent: Organize character/style reference, environment route, camera map, storyboard rows, lighting, audio, and cinematography notes into executable prompt_text guidance.
directives: Storyboard rows should inherit character/style reference, environment route, camera position, lighting mood, audio tone, and cinematography notes as compact production guidance.
Each row should carry camera type, shot size, movement mode, action, emotion, sound cue, and duration when supported by the current fragment.
Prompt text must remain a user-facing generation prompt, not a visual planning board or internal knowledge dump.
negative_constraints: Do not output layout instructions or a full visual planning board.
Do not expose source images, raw prompt text, local paths, or internal wiki IDs.
Do not expand beyond the selected storyboard task fragment and duration.

director_rule_packs.name: Seedance2 storyboard field discipline
director_rule_packs.intent: Turn Seedance-oriented camera, expression, scene, light, and composition guidance into existing PWA storyboard fields without schema drift.
directives: Choose one primary camera movement and one compatible viewpoint for the current beat before compiling prompt_text.
Bind shot_size before expression detail: close shots may carry eye, lip, breath, and hand tension; wide shots should carry silhouette, spacing, route, and group motion.
Build visual_description from scene-supported space, subject placement, material, light direction, color temperature, air medium, composition, and depth cues.
Translate emotion into visible action such as gaze, breath, posture, hand motion, step, recoil, pause, or blocking relation.
Compile prompt_text from person, camera, shot_size, visual_description, character_action, dialogue_or_narration, duration_seconds, and safe negative constraints only.
negative_constraints: Do not add anime-only camera vocabulary when the scene style is grounded, documentary, or otherwise not anime-compatible.
Do not put camera, style, composition, source, or KB terms into person.
Do not force tiny facial muscle detail into wide, aerial, group, or battlefield-scale shots.
Do not use light, color, atmosphere, or composition as disconnected decoration.
Do not expose source or governance metadata in PWA output.

validation_rule_packs.name: Prompt text validation
validation_rule_packs.intent: Validate that prompt_text is present, aligned, and summary-only.
directives: prompt_text must be non-empty.
prompt_text must align with visual_description.
prompt_text must not include internal refs.
negative_constraints: No raw KB
No source register
No internal hashes

validation_rule_packs.name: No pseudo success
validation_rule_packs.intent: Prevent empty rows, missing prompt text, blocked state, stale tasks, or stale artifacts from being treated as success.
directives: Rows must be non-empty.
visual_description and prompt_text must be non-empty.
Blocked export cannot be marked ready.
negative_constraints: No rows=0 success
No blocked export as ready

validation_rule_packs.name: No leakage
validation_rule_packs.intent: Prevent raw KB, source registers, prompt bodies, internal refs, local paths, provider config, keys, tokens, and secrets from leaking.
directives: raw_kb_rows_included must be 0.
source_register, overlay_json, prompt_body, raw_graph, local paths, provider config, keys, tokens, and secrets must be absent.
User exports must not include internal hashes or refs.
negative_constraints: No raw KB
No prompt body
No local paths
No secrets

validation_rule_packs.name: Duration integrity
validation_rule_packs.intent: Validate duration sum, row duration, and duration-density boundaries.
directives: Row durations must sum to the target duration.
No row may have zero duration.
Repeated full-budget rows are invalid.
negative_constraints: No duration mismatch
No zero-duration row

validation_rule_packs.name: Person identity lock
validation_rule_packs.intent: Keep the person field limited to accepted story characters or explicit role labels while blocking location, action, scene, camera, style, KB, and placeholder terms.
directives: person must preserve only accepted-body characters or explicit role labels.
Reject location, action fragment, scene term, camera term, style term, KB term, slash, dash, or empty placeholder in person.
When the person field is uncertain, leave it empty or repair from accepted facts instead of inventing a new name.
negative_constraints: Do not invent character names.
Do not put location, action, camera, visual style, source, or KB terms into person.
Do not expose governance wording in user exports.
